Council Transmittal Letter

 

I.        Planning Commission Recommendation: By a vote of 6 to 0, the Planning Commission recommended approval of the applications.

 

II.      Request: To amend the existing proffers and allow a kennel at 111 Pennsylvania Avenue.

 

III.    Applicant: Meowkins

 

IV.   Description: 

·         The site is located on the southeast corner of Omohundro and Pennsylvania Avenues, west of Granby Street, in the Riverview neighborhood.

·         The site was conditionally rezoned from residential into the Riverview PCO and C-C district in 2007.

o       The conditions from that rezoning limit the uses of the property to retail services and goods, art gallery, and office activities.

·         The site previously operated as One Eleven Art, an art gallery.

·         The applicant is proposing to open a cat kennel.

o       A kennel would not be allowed under the current zoning conditions, so the applicant is amending the conditions to allow Kennel.

o       The Riverview PCO was amended in May to allow Kennel by CUP, following similar amendment requests in other PCO districts.

o       The kennel will be open to the public from 9:00 a.m. until 6:00 p.m., seven days a week.

 

V.     Payment of Taxes

As of May 11, the owner of the property is current on all taxes. 

 

VI.   Communications/Outreach

·         Notice was sent to the Riverview/Colonial Place Civic League (RVCPCL) on May 13.

·         The applicant met with the RVCPCL on March 9.

·         Staff received a letter of support from the RCVPCL on March 11.

·         The Riverview Business Association sent a letter of support on March 6.

·         Legal notice was posted on the property on May 19.

·         Letters were mailed to all property owners within 300 feet of the property on June 9.

·         Legal notification was placed in The Virginian-Pilot on June 11 and 18.

 

Staff contact: Robert Brennan at Robert.Brennan@Norfolk.gov
